Scanned this document for installation-journal, transaction, install-route error and on-disk-state claims; none is contradicted (grants, consent, renderer selection and success responses are unchanged).

Updated the install trust records paragraph: the file fails closed only once the migration has written it, the refusal names the recovery, and an install over a newer Station's record is refused; checked against plugin-install-trust-store.ts migrationState, the transaction's newer-record check and the migration tests (rebuild, recovery, 409).

Rewrote the part 2a bound, journal and missing-file bullets for the third fix round and added the per-record versioning rule: fileWritten-gated rebuild of an unwritten file, fail closed with the exact completed-marker recovery once written (the marker is final and the journal follows it), the 1024 bound grandfathering none on overflow, one retry on a concurrent first attempt, newer records read unreadable and refuse installs with 409, and 'a tree whose bytes differ from the record'. Checked against the store, journal, migration wrapper, transaction and tests with fault injection.

Install route: added 409 plugin-trust-record-newer and described every 503 plugin-trust-records-unavailable cause (malformed file, file or marker missing after the first write, journal read/write failure) and the recovery; update and registry-copy routes reference the same causes and the update pulls nothing on 503. Checked against plugin-install-routes.ts, plugin-lifecycle-routes.ts and the new update-route 503 and install 409 tests.
